items.source_excerpt: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF) ranked as the world’s most valuable sovereign wealth fund brand for the third consecutive year, according to Brand Finance. The ranking reflects PIF’s efforts to build confidence in its global brand, whose value rose from $1.183 billion in 2025 to $1.2 billion in 2026, while its rating improved from A+ to AA-. The brand is the most valuable among sovereign wealth funds and global investment institutions outside the United States and Europe, and the only sovereign wealth fund brand valued above $1 billion.
